origine_fr: À gauche, 讠, la parole ; à droite, 兑 (丷 sur 口 et 儿), qui donnait le son. Il se lit aujourd'hui duì, loin de shuō. C'est dire, parler, expliquer.
origine_en: On the left, 讠, speech; on the right, 兑 (丷 over 口 and 儿), which gave the sound. Today it is read duì, far from shuō. It means to say, to speak, to explain.
sens_en: to say, to speak, to explain
